hypothesis: Independent adversarial evaluation will prevent us from mistaking complexity, benchmark leakage, or attractive demos for progress.
falsification_condition: A vacuous PASS advances; a REJECT fails to block status=done; a reject/risk finding produces no task draft; a simpler checklist/schema matches reject/spawn.
baseline_results: ChecklistOnlyAccepts accepted testdata/rubber_stamp-equivalent prose. docs/tasks/eval-report.schema.json accepts testdata/rubber_stamp.json. Fluent 24+ char aesthetic evidence advanced under vacuousEvidence in internal/evalgate/gate.go.
cost_latency_model_calls: go test -race ./internal/evalgate/ ~1.0s; 200 Decide calls budget 200ms; 0 model calls in-gate

evidence: internal/evalgate/gate.go vacuousEvidence: len>=24 is treated as non-vacuous. Evidence 'The architecture is elegant and clearly better than a queue.' has no path or metric and would Advance.
TaskMayBecomeDone has no callers outside internal/evalgate/gate_test.go. .github/workflows/ci.yml has no evalgate step. docs/results/MESH-108/ was listed before a report existed.
evaluators.strongest_objection: The published falsification already holds: a fluent vacuous PASS can advance. The gate checks report shape and short aesthetic tokens, not scientific content.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: A human reading docs/tasks/EVALUATORS.md, or JSON Schema plus a few required-field rules, rejects the same short rubber-stamp fixture. ChecklistOnlyAccepts was written to lose.
evaluators.target_challenge: yes — independent adversarial evaluation is not operationalized by structural validation
evaluators.next_experiment: Reject fluent-aesthetic-only evidence; bind Decide to the done-status path.
evaluators.what_would_reverse_conclusion: Decide returns advance=false on fluent aesthetic-only evidence; a real done transition cannot occur with composite REJECT; a non-handicapped schema checker fails a case the Go gate catches.

findings.summary: Vacuous PASS still advances when evidence is fluent aesthetic prose
findings.evidence: internal/evalgate/gate.go vacuousEvidence: len>=24 is non-vacuous. testdata/rubber_stamp.json only fails the short-phrase regex.

proposed_task.title: Reject fluent-but-empty evaluator evidence
proposed_task.hypothesis: Validate will reject reports whose evidence is only aesthetic prose, including strings longer than 24 characters with no path, metric, or named artifact.
proposed_task.falsification_condition: A fixture whose evidence is fluent aesthetic text with no path or metric still returns Advance=true.

findings.summary: Done-status path is not bound to evalgate
findings.evidence: TaskMayBecomeDone is only referenced from internal/evalgate/gate_test.go; ci.yml does not invoke evalgate.

proposed_task.title: Bind evalgate to the research-loop done transition
proposed_task.hypothesis: A task cannot become status=done without a valid advancing evalgate Decision.
proposed_task.falsification_condition: tasks.json can still be set to done with no report or with composite_verdict=REJECT.

evidence: internal/evalgate/gate.go ChecklistOnlyAccepts is a 4-line substring check. TestGate_BaselineChecklistAcceptsRubberStampThatGateRejects uses a handicapped baseline.
docs/tasks/eval-report.schema.json accepts testdata/rubber_stamp.json: required fields present, no vacuous-text rule.
evaluators.strongest_objection: The claimed gain is vs ChecklistOnlyAccepts, not vs JSON Schema. Tightening the schema plus jq decide/spawn likely ties reject/spawn.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: Enforce a tightened eval-report.schema.json with if/then plus a jq decide/spawn wrapper; do not keep a Go package to beat an unenforced checklist.
evaluators.target_challenge: yes — beating ChecklistOnlyAccepts is the wrong metric; a simpler schema can match reject/spawn on field presence
evaluators.next_experiment: Compare evalgate to a schema-only required-field checker on testdata/*.json and a fluent-empty fixture.

findings.summary: Schema-only checker ties on field presence; ChecklistOnlyAccepts is handicapped
findings.evidence: testdata/rubber_stamp.json is schema-valid but fails Validate only on short vacuousEvidence. Spawn equals a filter over reject|risk proposed_task.

proposed_task.title: Compare evalgate to a non-handicapped schema-only checker
proposed_task.hypothesis: A required-field schema checker matches evalgate on valid_pass/valid_reject shape and accepts rubber_stamp.json.
proposed_task.falsification_condition: The schema-only checker rejects testdata/rubber_stamp.json or fails to accept testdata/valid_pass.json.

evidence: internal/evalgate/gate.go DecodeReport caps at MaxReportBytes=256KiB. go test -race ./internal/evalgate/ ~1.0s. TestGate_DecideLatency budgets 200 Decide calls at 200ms. cmd/evalgate/main.go makes 0 model calls.
evaluators.strongest_objection: TestGate_DecideLatency is a loose wall-clock budget on already-decoded reports, not ns/op on a 256KiB payload.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: A CI JSON Schema check on the same bounded file is the same cost class without a Go package.
evaluators.target_challenge: no — this is an offline JSON gate, not a colony throughput path
evaluators.next_experiment: Time DecodeReport+Decide on a near-MaxReportBytes report.

evidence: internal/evalgate/gate_test.go TestGate_MalformedAndHugeInputs: DecodeReport rejects oversized and malformed JSON; Validate(nil) errors; Spawn(nil) is empty.
LoadReport in internal/evalgate/gate.go uses os.ReadFile before LimitReader, so the CLI size bound is post-hoc.
evaluators.strongest_objection: The agent-facing path slurps the file unbounded before MaxReportBytes applies.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: A size-capped json.Decoder plus JSON Schema rejects malformed reports without a custom failure model.
evaluators.target_challenge: no — file-shaped gate, not a worker lease protocol
evaluators.next_experiment: Stat/LimitReader in LoadReport so CLI cannot allocate more than MaxReportBytes+1.

findings.summary: LoadReport/CLI size bound is post-hoc, not a memory fence
findings.evidence: internal/evalgate/gate.go LoadReport does os.ReadFile before DecodeReport LimitReader.

proposed_task.title: Bound LoadReport memory before decoding evalgate JSON
proposed_task.hypothesis: A file larger than MaxReportBytes fails via LoadReport without reading more than MaxReportBytes+1 bytes.
proposed_task.falsification_condition: LoadReport on a >MaxReportBytes tempfile succeeds or reads the whole file first.

evidence: cmd/evalgate/main.go is a 77-line wrapper; no CI script execs the binary. docs/tasks/eval-report.schema.json is never loaded and requires only id+verdict.
internal/evalgate/gate_test.go mixes scenario tests (rubber stamp, buried finding) with field-mirror tests. TaskMayBecomeDone is test-only.
evaluators.strongest_objection: Four encodings of one form contract plus a status gate nothing calls mistakes gate architecture for independent evaluation.
evaluators.strongest_simpler_explanation: Keep EVALUATORS.md, the five prompt packets, and one Validate/Decide implementation. Delete the unused CLI and schema until a status writer exists.
evaluators.target_challenge: The hypothesis is independent judgment; this artifact is a report-shape checker.
evaluators.next_experiment: Wire Decide to status=done and reject fluent-empty reports. Give the CLI a real caller or delete it.
evaluators.invariant_named: A report cannot Advance if any active evaluator or reject finding is REJECT, if composite disagrees with deriveVerdict, or if reject/risk findings lack proposed_task.
evaluators.deletion_candidate: ChecklistOnlyAccepts in the production package; TaskMayBecomeDone until it has a non-test caller.

findings.summary: Unused CLI and looser unused schema duplicate the Go gate
findings.evidence: cmd/evalgate has no production caller; docs/tasks/eval-report.schema.json is never loaded.

proposed_task.title: Give evalgate CLI a real caller or delete it
proposed_task.hypothesis: check-tasks will be the CLI's non-test caller; otherwise cmd/evalgate should be deleted.
proposed_task.falsification_condition: After the next round the CLI still has no non-test caller and is still in tree.
